basic.name: Price Gain Maximizer
basic.description: Pure price-gain corner: prioritises lowest buyer-paid price exclusively. Equivalent to PADPP Table 2's obj=Price Gain row (weight [1, 0, 0]).

basic.name: Fairness Maximizer
basic.description: Pure fairness corner: prioritises midpoint-priced outcomes exclusively. Equivalent to PADPP Table 2's obj=Fairness row (weight [0, 1, 0]).

basic.name: Deal Maximizer
basic.description: Pure deal-rate corner: prioritises closing any deal exclusively. Equivalent to PADPP Table 2's obj=Deal Rate row (weight [0, 0, 1]).

advanced.name: Uniform Balancer
advanced.description: Uniform preference across all three objectives. Equivalent to PADPP Table 2's Uniform row (weight [1/3, 1/3, 1/3]).
